messages:
maria (docs): FYI starting a small docs PR to add a consumption calculator example for metering (usage tiers + burst credits). keeping it minimal, goal is a copy-paste snippet + worked example.
jonathan (eng): SGTM — do you want an SDK snippet and a curl example?
maria (docs): yes to both. SDK in py + node, plus a short note about rounding and units.
liam (product): please call out tier boundaries and where the dashboard shows meter breakdowns. PMs will use this in enablement.
samira (docs): i can help proof the worked example. do we have a canonical pricing table to reference?
maria (docs): linking internal pricing sheet: https://redwood.internal/pricing/consumption-v2 (note: internal) — will paste the relevant rows in the PR.
jonathan (eng): quick check: when calculating token-units for embeddings vs. generation, call out that embeddings use per-embedding-unit not per-token. i.e. avoid mixing units.
maria (docs): good catch. will add a short "units" section. also plan to show a table: request -> tokens -> unit cost -> total.
docs-bot: A PR has been opened by maria in docs repo: PR #1180 — "metering consumption calculator examples" :github: 
liam (product): PR link?
maria (docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1180 — main files: /guides/metering/calculator.md and /snippets/sdk/consumption_examples.py
jonathan (eng): quick review notes: 1) include the 95th percentile guidance for burstable tenants; 2) show a fallback for unknown meter types (i.e. log and contact support).
samira (docs): also suggest adding a tiny UI screenshot showing the dashboard panel where the tier and consumed units appear — helps orientation. i can take a screenshot from staging.
maria (docs): added TODOs in the PR for screenshot and p95 note. leaving the sample numbers intentionally small.
jonathan (eng): small nit — in the python snippet you have `total_cost = tokens * 0.002` but for some tiers the rate is 0.0015 for committed capacity. maybe show a commented alternative: `# committed_rate = 0.0015`
maria (docs): done, added inline comment and a short paragraph about committed vs on-demand rates.
liam (product): we should also mention quota behavior: soft limit alerts vs hard cutoff. brief line is fine.
maria (docs): added one-liner and link to quota docs.
docs-bot: PR #1180 updated (3 commits) — reviewers requested: jonathan, samira.
jonathan (eng): reviewing now — will leave line comments.
samira (docs): i'll do a language pass after jonathan's engineering comments.
deploy-bot: staging preview for PR #1180 is available at https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/1180 (expires in 7 days)
liam (product): can we get the staging screenshot from that preview?
samira (docs): yes grabbing it now.
maria (docs): thanks all — plan to merge once comments are addressed. ETA EOD tomorrow. ping here if that slips. :thumbsup:
jonathan (eng): left two small code comments. nothing blocking.
samira (docs): pushed screenshot commit and a couple microcopy tweaks.
docs-bot: PR #1180 merged by maria (docs) — commit 9a7b1c2 — "metering: add consumption calculator examples + screenshot"
maria (docs): merged. i'll update related redirects for snippets in a follow-up.
liam (product): awesome, great job everyone.
jonathan (eng): nice and clean. :rocket:
samira (docs): will add the snippet to the examples index in a separate PR later.
maria (docs): thread closed unless someone needs more changes."
